verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents dataset-wide evaluation runs (execute across many examples with configurable concurrency/repetitions), bulk trace filter/export/share/compare via API, and bulk dataset creation from historical traces or synthetic generation—supporting operations across many items at once. However, there's no explicit documentation of general bulk actions (e.g., bulk delete/tag/annotate across arbitrary trace sets) beyond evaluation and dataset contexts, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk-op reliability at scale. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/delete/tag API documentation, independent hands-on verification of large-scale bulk operations.
